items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Yeah, rag, we didn't call it no jazz then. You see, because everything was Scott Joplin then. Yeah. See, and we played all, any time any musician could play Scott Joplin's, I've got the books.

ctx.x: I thought you were in Clarence Jones.
One time Clarence Williams did have a publishing house here at your music store.
